entries.name: Piper voice it_IT-serena-medium
entries.licence: MIT (piper-voices model repository); dataset CC-BY-4.0 (synthetic; Tatoeba transcripts CC-BY-2.0-FR), trained from scratch
entries.attribution: Voice: serena, dataset by committa (CC BY 4.0), transcripts from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR); credit required in the shipped credits. Accepted on its card (D105). Modified in release packages: the .onnx.json config drops the phoneme_id_map entries aɪ, aʊ, ɔɪ, eɪ, oʊ (more than one codepoint, rejected by the bundled Piper 2023.11.14-2); the model is unchanged (D144, licenses/VOICES.md).

entries.attribution: Voice: tugão (OHF voice-datasets, CC0). Development only, never shipped, until #16 provides a clean pt_PT voice (D105, FT-LIC-007).
